text: By the time the river fog lifted over Kestrel Quay on Tuesday, the answer to a question that had hovered for weeks was plain enough: Stradal Group has acquired Fennimore Optics. The deal, announced from Stradal’s brick-and-glass headquarters on Alder Street, closes a 41-year chapter for the lens maker, whose workshop began as a two-room supplier to dockside surveyors in 1983 and grew into a respected niche manufacturer. Industry filings put the purchase at 68.4 million crown notes, with Fennimore’s 220 employees expected to remain in place through the winter. For longtime observers, the sale feels less like an ending than another turn in Northfold’s slow industrial tide, where family firms, once anchored in place, are increasingly drawn into larger hands.
